metadata.name: Agentic AI Healthcare Medical Knowledge Base
metadata.purpose: Starter retrieval knowledge base for a healthcare decision-support prototype
metadata.primary_source: MedlinePlus / U.S. National Library of Medicine
metadata.scope_note: This knowledge base supports information retrieval and clinical-context briefing. It is not a diagnostic or treatment authority.

diseases.name: Hepatitis C
diseases.description: Hepatitis C is inflammation of the liver caused by the hepatitis C virus. It can be acute or chronic.
diagnostic_context: additional liver-damage tests may include blood tests, liver ultrasound, or liver biopsy
diseases.important_context: Many people with hepatitis C have no symptoms, especially during chronic infection.

diseases.name: Gastroenteritis
diseases.description: Gastroenteritis is inflammation of the lining of the stomach and intestines.
diseases.important_context: Gastroenteritis can sometimes lead to dehydration or severe symptoms.

diseases.name: GERD
diseases.description: GERD is a chronic condition in which stomach contents can move back into the esophagus and cause irritation.
diseases.important_context: Chest pain with shortness of breath or pain in the jaw or arm requires medical evaluation because it can indicate a heart problem.

diseases.name: Peptic ulcer
diseases.description: A peptic ulcer is a sore in the lining of the stomach or duodenum.
diagnostic_context: testing for Helicobacter pylori may use blood, breath, or stool tests
endoscopy may be used to examine the stomach and duodenum
diseases.important_context: A perforated ulcer is a medical emergency; gastrointestinal bleeding can also be serious.

diseases.name: Migraine
diseases.description: Migraine is a recurring type of headache that can cause moderate to severe throbbing or pulsing pain.
diagnostic_context: clinical history and symptom pattern are important
evaluation may consider the characteristics and phases of the headache
diseases.important_context: Migraine symptoms can occur in phases, and not every person experiences every phase.

diseases.name: Asthma
diseases.description: Asthma is a chronic lung disease in which the airways can become inflamed and narrowed.
diagnostic_context: allergy skin or blood tests when appropriate
diseases.important_context: Asthma attacks can become severe and may sometimes be life-threatening.

diseases.name: Hypertension
diseases.description: Hypertension is the medical term for high blood pressure.
diagnostic_context: blood pressure measurements are used to assess blood pressure
repeated measurements are important for evaluating persistent high blood pressure
diseases.important_context: Untreated high blood pressure can increase the risk of serious problems including heart disease, stroke, kidney disease, and eye problems.

diseases.name: Paralysis (brain hemorrhage)
diseases.description: A hemorrhagic stroke occurs when a blood vessel in the brain bursts and causes bleeding in or around the brain.
diagnostic_context: brain imaging to check for bleeding
diseases.important_context: Stroke symptoms often begin suddenly. Sudden weakness, speech difficulty, vision problems, severe headache, or loss of balance require urgent medical evaluation.

diseases.name: (vertigo) Paroymsal Positional Vertigo
diseases.description: Benign positional vertigo is a common type of vertigo caused by a problem in the inner ear.
diseases.important_context: Vertigo is typically a spinning sensation. New weakness, slurred speech, or vision problems alongside vertigo can indicate a more serious condition.

diseases.name: Heart attack
diseases.description: A heart attack occurs when blood flow to part of the heart becomes blocked and the heart muscle is deprived of oxygen.
diseases.important_context: A suspected heart attack is a medical emergency and requires prompt medical evaluation.
